metadata.title: Mid-Century Pop Album Cover with Obi Strip

recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage-style album cover featuring a high-contrast, warm-toned portrait of a smiling woman with a 1950s hairstyle, accented by a vertical yellow obi strip on the left containing dense vertical text and a large white script signature overlaying the bottom center.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical yellow obi strip acts as a structural frame for the left edge.
The white script signature provides a fluid counterpoint to the rigid vertical text.
The warm yellow background harmonizes with the subject's brown clothing and skin tones.
The subject's gaze and smile create a direct emotional connection with the viewer.
coreInvariants: Monolinear script lettering for the primary name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, slightly angled.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large white script signature at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the script signature, then shifts left to the vertical text on the obi strip.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid yellow field behind the subject's head providing high contrast for the dark hair.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and black (hair and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (script lettering and neck scarf)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows; high value contrast between the white text and the warm mid-tones.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features an exaggerated loop that extends above the x-height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid, organic script paired with rigid, geometric vertical blocks.
graphicDevices: Rectangular price/code boxes at the bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century monoline script feel.
Approximates the dense, blocky feel of the vertical metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1950s technicolor-style portrait of a smiling woman with brunette bouffant hair and a white patterned neck scarf against a solid golden-yellow background. Leave a vertical yellow margin on the far left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white monolinear script name across the bottom center with a flourish underline. Add dense vertical text in blue and black within the left yellow margin, including small boxed numerical data at the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the script lettering monolinear and white?
Is the left margin a distinct yellow vertical strip?
Does the portrait have a warm, vintage photographic quality?
Is the text on the left oriented vertically?

mustAchieve: Structured vertical hierarchy in the margin
avoid: Overly thin or high-contrast script fonts

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script does not obscure the subject's eyes or mouth.
Check that the vertical text is aligned within the obi strip.
Verify the color palette remains strictly warm and golden.
Confirm the white script has no drop shadow for a flat vintage look.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a saturated technicolor portrait with a solid-color vertical sidebar and a centered monoline script signature for a mid-century import-style aesthetic.
